args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note on the PHL label confusion (Pellow Home Living vs Pellucid Harbor Logistics):

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb 2026. Both names sit under the "PHL" shorthand.
- "PHL" also means Pellucid Harbor Logistics (Gulf Coast port/terminal). Filtering "PHL" in the morning report returns both accounts.
- Moss's coverage digest (18 May) says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". It was added to the handoff list, and the old label was making the receiving supervisor search twice. We have not yet confirmed whether the saved report still carries the old label today.
- Moss's Coastal cheat sheet still lists the account as "Covey & Lark Retail (Covey / CLR / PHL)", so that needs updating too.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- Ask: please confirm the correct account name and org ID to use, and who owns the fix for the saved report label.

Thanks,
Bettina
